name: fx-proxy
description: OpenAI Responses API in front of Vercel's fx agent, with a Hot Glue wasm host layer

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:hma
scripts.build:fastly: node scripts/link.mjs src-hma/worker-fastly.hma dist/fastly/main.wasm && mkdir -p bin && cp dist/fastly/main.wasm bin/main.wasm
scripts.pack:fastly: npm run build:fastly && rm -rf pkg && fastly compute pack --wasm-binary bin/main.wasm
scripts.serve:fastly: npm run pack:fastly && fastly compute serve --skip-build
scripts.deploy:fastly: npm run pack:fastly && fastly compute deploy --package pkg/fx-proxy.tar.gz
